pages.name: conformance
pages.title: sf-chart-metric against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §12, gate 20)
pages.format: the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

body: <main style="inline-size: 40rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 1rem">
<sf-chart-metric id="r" label="Выручка за неделю" value="1250000" previous="1100000" format="currency-RUB" period-text="к прошлой неделе"></sf-chart-metric>
<sf-chart-metric id="l" label="Нагрузка CPU" value="0.82" previous="0.64" format="percent" better="down" status="warning" hint="Выше 80 %"></sf-chart-metric>

<sf-chart-metric id="o" label="Очередь" value="14" delta="-6" delta-format="absolute" better="down" openable><sf-chart-sparkline slot="chart" label="Очередь за день" summary="none"></sf-chart-sparkline></sf-chart-metric>

checks.title: a plain tile is a group named by its label; the value is formatted and the change says its direction in words
checks.covers: accessibility (role group, name label), settings.value, settings.previous, settings.format, settings.period-text

steps.check: (() => { const g = document.querySelector('#r [role=group]'); const t = (s) => s.replace(/[\u00a0\u202f]/gu, ' ').replace(/\s+/gu, ' ').trim(); return g && document.getElementById(g.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')).textContent.trim() === 'Выручка за неделю' && t(document.querySelector('#r .sf-chart-metric-value').textContent) === '1 250 000,00 ₽' && t(document.querySelector('#r .sf-chart-metric-change').textContent) === '▲ рост +13,6 %' && document.querySelector('#r .sf-chart-metric-change--positive') && !document.querySelector('#r [tabindex]'); })()

checks.title: better down makes a rise a change for the worse; the status is said in words before the hint
max draws a meter with its value text; the bar inside is hidden from the accessibility tree

steps.check: (() => { const m = document.querySelector('#s [role=meter]'); const t = (s) => s.replace(/[\u00a0\u202f]/gu, ' '); return m && m.getAttribute('aria-valuemax') === '100' && m.getAttribute('aria-valuenow') === '45.25' && t(m.getAttribute('aria-valuetext')) === '45,3 ГБ из 100 ГБ' && document.querySelector('#s sf-progress-bar').getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true' && document.querySelector('#s sf-progress-bar').getAttribute('value') === '45'; })()

checks.title: an openable tile is one button: Enter sends open; the chart slot holds the sparkline

steps.script: (() => { window.__opened = 0; const o = document.querySelector('#o'); o.addEventListener('sf-chart-metric-open', () => { window.__opened += 1; }); o.querySelector('sf-chart-sparkline').items = [20, 18, 22, 17, 14]; o.querySelector('button.sf-chart-metric').focus(); return true; })()

steps.check: (() => window.__opened === 1 && document.querySelector('#o .sf-chart-metric-change--positive') && /−6/u.test(document.querySelector('#o .sf-chart-metric-change').textContent) && document.activeElement === document.querySelector('#o button.sf-chart-metric') && document.querySelector('#o .sf-chart-metric-chart sf-chart-sparkline') && document.querySelectorAll('#o button a, #o button button').length === 0)()

checks.title: without a value the tile says «—»; loading keeps its size and is busy

steps.script: (() => { const e = document.querySelector('#e'); window.__h = e.getBoundingClientRect().height; e.setAttribute('data-state', 'loading'); return true; })()
